purpose: Region-defining skilling activities, reward shops, outfits, off-hands, tool chains, and production infrastructure for Equilibrium no-trading planning.

policy.region_rule: region_hint marks where the unlock or activity lives in the current planner taxonomy. region_hints marks a cross-region chain. Quest auto-completion and League-specific overrides must be applied separately.
policy.no_trade_rule: Prioritise unlocks that materially change self-sufficient progression, training throughput, supply access, or tool progression. Do not mirror every shop item.
policy.rate_rule: Do not promote stale XP/hour figures. Training rates belong in training datasets; this file records unlock state and effects.

activity_additions.name: Prifddinas skilling hub
unlocks: Ithell harmonium harps and harmonic dust
Trahaearn Seren stones and corrupted ore
Waterfall Fishing and crystal fishing rod shop
district skilling services and Voice of Seren rotations
activity_additions.notes: Prifddinas is far more than one training method. Treat it as a bundle of tool, shop, production, and high-level skilling unlocks when valuing Tirannwn.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Equilibrium explicitly advertises Prifddinas as Tirannwn content and says region quest completion is intended to provide immediate access. Keep any individual item skill requirements.

activity_additions.name: Crystal tool and harmonic dust infrastructure
unlocks: Harmonium harps as a low-attention harmonic-dust source
activity_additions.notes: Lady Ithell upgrades several dragon-tier tools with harmonic dust. Crystal pickaxes, hatchets, mattocks, fishing rods, tinderboxes and hammers also feed augmentable skilling progression.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Tirannwn supplies the crystal side of several late-game tool chains. Do not imply the other components of those chains are Tirannwn-only.

activity_additions.name: Waterfall Fishing and Fishing Shop
activity_additions.category: Fishing activity and permanent tool unlock
requirements: 93 Fishing for the high-level Waterfall Fishing route
90 Agility, Ranged and Strength for the waterfall route in the normal game
unlocks: Ability to make the crystal fishing rod for 3,000 crystal urchin points
activity_additions.notes: The crystal fishing rod is 5% more likely to catch fish and can be augmented. This makes Waterfall Fishing a permanent tool unlock as well as a training activity.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Keep the rod unlock even if Equilibrium XP multipliers make another fishing method faster.

activity_additions.name: Meilyr Recipe Shop and combination potions
activity_additions.notes: Some combination-potion recipes are purchased directly once requirements are met; others first need recipe discovery from Daemonheim or another source. Do not hard-code Forinthry as a requirement for every Meilyr recipe.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Tirannwn is the shop and production hub. Recipe-specific discovery dependencies remain separate.

activity_additions.name: Crystal sandstone and crystal flasks
requirements: 81 Mining for crystal-flecked sandstone in the normal game
89 Crafting for crystal flasks in the normal game
activity_additions.notes: Crystal sandstone is the local Prifddinas supply for crystal flasks. The 2026 DailyScape overhaul removed the old daily mining cap, so old daily-cap advice must not be used.
activity_additions.league_treatment: This is a major no-trading production unlock because it controls self-supplied combination-potion containers.

activity_additions.name: Motherlode Maw and Meilyr resource dungeons
requirements: 115 Dungeoneering for the Motherlode Maw resource dungeon
95 in normal skills for Maw rewards, including Necromancy
unlocks: Useful enhancers and high-level skilling rewards
activity_additions.notes: The Maw is a high-level Prifddinas reward source and can also help with otherwise awkward unlocks such as Meilyr potion recipes.
activity_additions.league_treatment: The activity lives in Tirannwn, but its 115 Dungeoneering requirement means Forinthry can still be a practical cross-region dependency in Equilibrium.

activity_additions.name: Seren stones and corrupted ore
activity_additions.category: AFK Mining and Smithing supply loop
activity_additions.notes: Seren stones are a durable Prifddinas skilling unlock even when they are not the absolute fastest Mining route. They matter for low-input training and self-supplied Smithing experience.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Keep this as a utility and AFK route, separate from pure XP/hour rankings.

activity_additions.name: Artisans' Workshop Reward Shop
unlocks: Blacksmith's outfit, up to 6% Smithing XP
activity_additions.notes: Blacksmith outfit pieces cost respect at the Reward Shop. Luminite injectors overload the workshop and add progress per smithing swing for players in the workshop.
activity_additions.league_treatment: This is a real Asgarnia skilling unlock bundle, not just the burial-smithing training method.

activity_additions.name: Deep Sea Fishing hub
unlocks: Deep Sea Fishing boosts and events
activity_additions.notes: Fishing Frenzy is already tracked as the high-XP route. The hub also adds lower-input food gathering, swarm fishing, a rotating merchant, and the rare Tavia's fishing rod acquisition path.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Merchant stock and currency practicality should be launch-checked, but hub access itself is a major Kandarin unlock.

activity_additions.name: Farmers' Market and master farmer outfit
activity_additions.category: Farming reward shop and elite outfit
requirements: 1,000 beans for the master farmer outfit blueprint
80 Farming and 20 Invention to manufacture outfit pieces
unlocks: Animal, crop and tree farmer outfit progression
activity_additions.notes: The master farmer outfit is an important permanent Farming progression target. Its animal-farming benefits include increased beans when selling animals.
activity_additions.league_treatment: No-trading increases the value of bean-shop and self-sufficient farm unlocks.

activity_additions.name: Pyramid Plunder and black ibis outfit
unlocks: Up to 5% Thieving XP with the full set
activity_additions.notes: Do not import old black-ibis drop-rate tables into League planning. The permanent outfit unlock is what matters here.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Treat this as Desert skilling progression even if a faster raw-XP Thieving method is available elsewhere.

activity_additions.name: Red sandstone and potion flasks
activity_additions.notes: Red sandstone at Oo'glog and Sophanem feeds potion-flask production. The 2026 DailyScape overhaul removed the old daily cap, and July 2026 reduced rock hitpoints.
activity_additions.league_treatment: This is the Desert half of high-end six-dose flask infrastructure; crystal flasks for combination potions are a separate Tirannwn unlock.

activity_additions.name: Temple Trekking skilling outfits
unlocks: Constructor's outfit, up to 6% Construction XP
activity_additions.notes: Temple Trekking is worth surfacing as permanent skilling progression, not just a minigame, because it owns two useful XP outfits.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Resolve normal quest access through the Equilibrium auto-quest overlay before treating the trek itself as manually gated.

activity_additions.name: Lava Flow Mine skilling unlocks
unlocks: Golden mining suit, 6% Mining XP with the full set
Imcando pickaxe fragments from lava geysers
activity_additions.notes: Keldagrim's Lava Flow Mine is the normal-game source for the golden mining suit and the Imcando-pickaxe branch of late-game Mining tool progression.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Keldagrim is treated as Fremennik-region geography. Resolve quest auto-completion separately.

activity_additions.name: Tier 3 Woodcutter's Grove and Imcando hatchet fragments
requirements: Tier 3 Woodcutter's Grove in the normal game
unlocks: Imcando hatchet fragment nests from Woodcutting
One guaranteed first fragment from Oak
activity_additions.notes: After tier 3 Grove is built, Imcando-hatchet fragments can appear in bird nests from Woodcutting. This makes Fort progression a permanent Woodcutting tool gate.
activity_additions.league_treatment: The repo currently maps Fort Forinthry to Misthalin using Catalyst precedent. Keep that mapping provisional until Equilibrium confirms it.

activity_additions.name: Ghostly sole fishing
activity_additions.notes: The spot does not move, making ghostly soles a useful low-input City of Um route and a practical place to level augmented fishing gear.
activity_additions.league_treatment: City of Um is currently a historical Misthalin working mapping, not an Equilibrium-specific locality confirmation.

activity_additions.name: Daemonheim skilling reward infrastructure
activity_additions.category: Dungeoneering reward shop and utility unlocks
unlocks: Gem bag and upgraded gem bag
Scroll and utility rewards used by skilling chains
activity_additions.notes: Equilibrium explicitly places Daemonheim in Forinthry, so Dungeoneering reward-store items are a real regional dependency in a no-trading planner.
activity_additions.league_treatment: Do not assume reward-token costs are altered unless Equilibrium publishes a multiplier or passive.

equipment_additions.name: Crystal fishing rod
effects: 5% more likely to catch fish at compatible fishing spots
Can be augmented for Invention perks
equipment_additions.league_treatment: A major permanent Fishing tool unlock even when Fishing Frenzy or another activity is better raw XP.

equipment_additions.name: Tavia's fishing rod
requirements: Rare red uncharted island map from Deep Sea Fishing or Travelling Merchant route
effects: 10% increased fishing success rate when compatible
Can trigger all three Deep Sea Fishing boosts
Can be augmented
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Record as a rare ceiling item, not baseline Kandarin power. A player cannot plan around obtaining it quickly.

equipment_additions.name: Trahaearn exoskeleton
requirements: Plague's End reward in the normal game
effects: 25% chance to avoid being stunned and damaged while pickpocketing
25% chance to avoid snake bites in Pyramid Plunder
Can inherit black ibis experience benefits once those are owned
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Prifddinas/Tirannwn is the useful regional value. Resolve the quest through Equilibrium auto-completion before treating it as a manual requirement.

equipment_additions.name: Sana's fyrtorch
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Use the canonical item name. The existing loose major-upgrade row used a non-item placeholder name for this reward.

equipment_additions.name: Tagga's corehammer
effects: +10% Mining critical strike chance
+35% Mining critical strike damage
Chance for deathspore arrow tips from core ores
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Use the canonical item name. The critical-strike bonuses remain useful outside core ores; only the arrow-tip effect is core-ore specific.

equipment_additions.name: Memory dowser
effects: Gather memories from wisps up to 7 tiles away
Supports ranged, low-movement Divination gathering
equipment_additions.league_treatment: City of Um/Gate is currently mapped to Misthalin by historical League precedent pending Equilibrium confirmation.

equipment_additions.name: Runic attuner
effects: Attunes to eligible Runecrafting altars
At 1-49 energy, attuned-altar crafting gains 200% additional Runecrafting XP
Every 5 energy gives a 50% rune multiplier at the attuned altar
Every 7 energy allows choosing an altar
Every 10 energy grants an attuned-altar teleport
Every 25 energy guarantees 1-4 magical thread
At 50 energy, attuned-altar crafting gains 2,400% additional Runecrafting XP and resets energy
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Use the post-29-September-2025 effect, not the original release tooltip. Do not assume it is always the best XP/hour route; altar sequence and Soul altar use matter.

equipment_additions.name: Orthen furnace core
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Track the unlock, but do not label it BIS for pure XP. Its situational effects can lose to augmented off-hands and other setups. Full sustained Superheat Form value is Anachronia plus Tirannwn combo pressure: dragon burners / furnace core from Orthen (Anachronia), Superheat Form and crystal hammer from Tirannwn. Do not claim dual dig sites. See cross-region:orthen-furnace-core-stack in the 2026-07-26 skilling-gaps enrichment.

equipment_additions.name: Imcando pickaxe
requirements: Golden mining suit before gilding a dragon pickaxe
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Do not use historical enchanted-Imcando bonus-XP data. The enchanted variant was removed in 2019.

equipment_additions.name: Pickaxe of Earth and Song
region_pressure: Imcando pickaxe progression comes from the Keldagrim/Lava Flow Mine chain.
Crystal pickaxe progression comes from Prifddinas crystal-tool infrastructure.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Treat Fremennik plus Tirannwn as the normal self-sufficient chain unless Equilibrium adds alternate tool sources.

equipment_additions.name: Imcando hatchet
requirements: Imcando hatchet fragments from bird nests
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Use the Fort's current working Misthalin taxonomy until Equilibrium publishes a different boundary.

equipment_additions.name: Skeka's hypnowand
requirements: Read the aged journal in the Warped Depths of the Daemonheim Dig Site before pieces can drop
region_pressure: Forinthry owns Daemonheim and the Warped Depths journal gate.
Pieces then come from Anachronia activities including Big Game Hunter, Rex Matriarchs, vile blooms and the Agility Course.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Do not label this Anachronia-only. The Daemonheim journal gate is a real Forinthry dependency in the normal acquisition path.

equipment_additions.name: Balarak's sash brush
effects: +5% excavation success rate
+5% mattock base precision
10% chance for an additional material while excavating
5% chance for Chronal Focus at 100% sprite focus
region_pressure: Brush pieces come from the Warped Depths of the Daemonheim Dig Site.
The damaged brush is shown to Sharrigan outside Anachronia Base Camp to learn restoration.
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Surface both Forinthry and Anachronia in planner dependencies.

equipment_additions.name: Artificer's measure
equipment_additions.category: Crafting and Construction skilling off-hand cross-region chain
requirements: Chain link mould from the Legacy of Seergaze route
Crystal-flecked sandstone or an alternate player-owned ports source
effects: Stores gems like the upgraded gem bag
Always applies the Ithell Voice of Seren harp benefit while playing harps
5% chance to duplicate glassblown items and urns, including potion and crystal flasks
Scroll of proficiency chance multiplied by 1.25
Crafting/Construction buff can stack to 5% after proficiency procs
equipment_additions.league_treatment: Do not hard-require every listed region. Crystal sandstone has an alternate Ports source and quest auto-completion can change the mould route, but region choices strongly affect self-sufficient acquisition.
